what: The planned regression test pre-seeds waterfall-group-results.tsv before invoking the dispatcher, but the dispatcher truncates that ledger at startup whenever any fallback_group is present.
scenario_or_breakage: The stale ok row is erased before phase 2, so the new test exercises the normal fresh-launch-and-reuse path instead of the proposed cp-failure fallback; it can pass even if reuse_slot_result still aborts on cp failure.
suggested_fix: Seed the stale ledger after dispatcher startup or construct the stale row during the run, for example with a first grouped slot whose successful output is deleted before a later grouped slot attempts reuse; alternatively add a focused shell-level harness around reuse failure only if it can validate the real phase-2 caller path.
